description: Header file containing utility methods and enums for GLSL to HLSL translation in the ANGLE project, including texture type definitions and string conversion functions.

methods.name: TextureGroup
methods.description: Returns the HLSL texture group enum based on the basic type and internal format.

methods.name: TextureString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a texture group or type.

methods.name: TextureGroupSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix string for a given texture group.

methods.name: TextureTypeSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix string for a given type and internal format.

methods.name: RWTextureGroup
methods.description: Returns the RWTexture group enum based on the type and internal format.

methods.name: RWTextureString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of an RWTexture group.

methods.name: RWTextureGroupSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix string for a given RWTexture group.

methods.name: RWTextureTypeSuffix
methods.description: Returns the suffix string for a given RWTexture type and internal format.

methods.name: SamplerString
methods.description: Returns the sampler string for a given type or texture group.

methods.name: Decorate
methods.description: Adds a prefix to user-defined names to avoid naming clashes.

methods.name: DecorateVariableIfNeeded
methods.description: Decorates a variable name if needed.

methods.name: DecorateFunctionIfNeeded
methods.description: Decorates a function name if needed.

methods.name: DecorateField
methods.description: Decorates a structure field name.

methods.name: DecoratePrivate
methods.description: Decorates a private name.

methods.name: TypeString
methods.description: Returns the string representation of a type.

methods.name: StructNameString
methods.description: Returns the name string of a structure.

methods.name: QualifiedStructNameString
methods.description: Returns the qualified name string of a structure with packing options.

methods.name: InterpolationString
methods.description: Returns the interpolation string for a qualifier.

methods.name: QualifierString
methods.description: Returns the string for a qualifier.

methods.name: DisambiguateFunctionName
methods.description: Disambiguates function names based on parameters.
